label: PF Backlog 114
title: AI-Integration Recommendation (MANDATORY ask, OPTIONAL implement) - product MOAT
body:
product-owner (0b) + architect (2) MUST produce an ai-integration-recommendation: the product's runtime AI capability, workflow, data, models, guardrails, cost, and the differentiation/MOAT it creates. Mandatory to ASK; OPTIONAL to IMPLEMENT. If accepted, spawn optional stage 4g AI Integration + config.
API-FIRST (owner convention): expose this capability through the backend API with a stable contract; the dashboard consumes ONLY the API (no direct store access/writes).

dashboard_impact.reason: The AI-integration recommendation (MOAT) must be shown + accept/implement toggle.
